title: Best Classplus Alternative (2026): 6 Options, Prices Checked
description: Six Classplus alternatives for coaching institutes, compared fairly: published prices from each official site, fees on sales, own app and domain, and who each one suits.
og_description: We checked every price on the official site. Graphy, Learnyst, Edmingle, Teachmint, AppX and AllCoaching compared for coaching institutes, including when staying on Classplus makes sense.
h1: Best Classplus Alternative for Coaching Institutes (2026): 6 Options, Prices Checked
dek: An honest comparison of the six platforms coaching institutes most often consider instead of Classplus, with every price taken from the official site and dated, and a clear answer on which one fits which institute.
cover_alt: Looking for a Classplus alternative: six options compared, with prices checked on official sites on 24 Oct 2026
audience: Coaching institute owners and independent educators in India comparing Classplus alternatives
intro: The best Classplus alternative depends on what you want to change: the price you pay before you earn, how much of the app and website you own, or the kind of teaching you do. For an institute that wants its own website and Android app (iOS app on Pro and Scale), built without a sales call and paid for mostly as it sells, AllCoaching is the closest fit. For a test-heavy exam academy, Learnyst is strong. For a creator selling to an existing audience, Graphy is built for that. And for an institute already selling above about ₹2.3 lakh a year, staying on Classplus can cost less on paper.

We are AllCoaching, so read this knowing who wrote it. To keep it fair, every competitor price below comes from that company's own website, with the link and the date we checked it, and we say plainly where another platform fits better than ours.

Classplus itself now publishes its prices: ₹29,999 for 1 year and ₹39,999 for 2 years on its pricing page. That page does not state GST, a fee on your sales, or the renewal price. Those are the questions to ask before you compare anything.
takeaways: Classplus lists ₹29,999 for 1 year and ₹39,999 for 2 years on its own pricing page (checked 24 Oct 2026); GST, any fee on sales and renewal price are not stated there.
AllCoaching starts at ₹6,999 a year plus a 10% fee on sales (Starter), with Growth ₹12,999 + 7.5%, Pro ₹24,999 + 5% and Scale ₹99,999 + 0%; GST extra, 7-day free trial with no card.
On published prices, AllCoaching costs less up to about ₹2.3 lakh of sales a year; above that, Classplus's flat listed price is lower on paper, before any fees it may charge.
Learnyst publishes ₹10,000 a year + 10% (Launcher) and 0%-fee plans from ₹8,099 a month billed annually; Edmingle starts at ₹7,499 a month billed annually; both add taxes.
Teachmint and AppX do not list prices on their websites; both start with a demo or a sales conversation.
Every AllCoaching plan includes your own domain and your own Android app (iOS app on Pro and Scale), built by you in the studio, with unlimited live classes and UPI checkout.
You can switch without losing students by running both platforms side by side until the current batch finishes.

sections.h2: How we compared Classplus and its alternatives
sections.html:
We compared six platforms that coaching institutes in India most often shortlist against Classplus: Graphy, Learnyst, Edmingle, Teachmint, AppX and AllCoaching. We looked at five things an institute owner pays for or depends on.

  1. Price you can see before signing up, taken only from each company's own pricing page.
  2. Fee on your sales, because a percentage changes the total as you grow.
  3. What you own: your domain, your app listing and your student data.
  4. How you start: self-serve sign-up or a demo and sales call.
  5. Who it is built for: coaching institutes, test-series academies, creators or training businesses.
Disclosure: AllCoaching publishes this guide. Competitor figures link to their official pages and carry the date we checked them (24 Oct 2026). Prices change; check the source before you decide. If you spot an error, write to contact@allcoaching.in and we will correct it.

sections.h2: Why coaching institutes look for a Classplus alternative
sections.html:
Classplus is an established platform that has helped many institutes get online quickly, and for some it remains the right choice. The reasons owners start comparing usually fall into three groups.

1. Paying a large amount before the first sale

Classplus lists ₹29,999 for one year. For a new or small institute, that is a large cost to commit before students have paid anything. Platforms with a lower yearly price and a percentage on sales move more of the cost to when you are actually earning.

2. Questions the pricing page leaves open

The Classplus pricing page (checked 24 Oct 2026) does not state GST, whether a fee is taken on your sales, or what renewal costs. None of these is unusual on its own, but together they make the true yearly cost hard to compare. Ask for them in writing.

{{q:Is Classplus bad, or have I outgrown it?|Usually neither. Classplus does what it says: it gets an institute online with an app. Owners look elsewhere when their needs change, for example wanting a website on their own domain, a lower cost at their current sales level, or setting things up themselves without a sales call.}}

3. Wanting to build and change things yourself

Many owners now want to edit their own website, add a course or change a price in minutes, without raising a request. That is the main reason self-serve platforms, where you build the academy in a studio yourself, have grown in 2026.

{{fig:before-after|Before and after: batches run across WhatsApp, Google Drive, UPI screenshots and Google Forms, compared with one academy login with your own website, app, live classes, checkout and tests|Whatever you choose, the goal is the same: one place for your courses, students and payments.}}

sections.h2: Which Classplus alternative fits your institute
sections.html:
Solo tutor or new institute (under ₹1 lakh a year)

Keep fixed costs low and start quickly. A self-serve platform with a low yearly price and a 7-day trial lets you build, test and sell before committing. Our guide on how to sell courses online in India covers the first sale.

Growing institute (₹1–5 lakh a year)

Compare the total at your real sales level, not the headline price. Own domain and own app start to matter here, because they build your brand rather than the platform's. See LMS with a custom domain.

Large institute (well above ₹5 lakh a year)

Flat-price plans can win on cost. Weigh that against ownership, multi-teacher needs and how quickly you can change things yourself. Our best LMS for coaching institutes guide compares more options.

Test-series academy

If most revenue comes from mocks, look closely at test engines such as Learnyst, and compare with building tests inside your own academy. See how to create mock tests online.

sections.h2: How to switch from Classplus without losing students
sections.html:
The safe way to switch is to run both platforms side by side. Current students stay where they are until their batch ends; new admissions go to your new academy.

{{fig:switch|Four steps to switch from Classplus: build your academy, run both side by side, move new admissions, close the old plan after the last batch|Nobody loses access, and nobody pays twice.}} {{steps}}

The full checklist, including messages to send students, is in how to switch coaching apps without losing students.

items: Start the 7-day trial, connect your domain and upload one complete course with its demo lesson.
Run both platforms side by side
Keep current students on Classplus until their batch or validity ends, so nobody loses access.
Send new admissions to your academy
Share your own website and app link in WhatsApp, YouTube and Instagram for every new batch.
Export records and close the old plan
Download student and payment records, then let the Classplus plan end at renewal.

faq: What is the best Classplus alternative in 2026?

It depends on your need. AllCoaching fits institutes that want their own website and Android app (iOS app on Pro and Scale) built themselves, from ₹6,999 a year plus a fee on sales. Learnyst suits test-heavy academies, Graphy suits creators with an audience, Edmingle suits training businesses, and staying on Classplus can cost less if you sell above about ₹2.3 lakh a year.
How much does Classplus cost in 2026?

Classplus lists ₹29,999 for 1 year and ₹39,999 for 2 years on its pricing page (classplusapp.com/new-web, checked 24 Oct 2026). The page does not state GST, any fee on sales or the renewal price, so ask for those in writing.
Is there a Classplus alternative with published pricing?

Yes. AllCoaching publishes Starter ₹6,999, Growth ₹12,999 and Pro ₹24,999 a year plus a 10%, 7.5% or 5% fee, or Scale at ₹99,999 with 0% on sales. Learnyst publishes Launcher at ₹10,000 a year plus 10% and monthly plans with 0% fees, and Edmingle publishes plans from ₹7,499 a month billed annually. Teachmint and AppX do not list prices.

On published prices, AllCoaching costs less up to about ₹2.3 lakh of sales a year, because its plans start at ₹6,999 and the fee applies only to sales. Above that, Classplus's flat listed price is lower on paper, before any fees Classplus may charge.
Can I get my own app and domain without Classplus?
Yes. Every AllCoaching plan includes a website on your own connected domain and your own white-label Android app (iOS app on Pro and Scale), which you set up yourself in the studio.
Can I move from Classplus without losing students?
Yes. Build your new academy, keep current students on Classplus until their batch ends, send new admissions to your own website and app, then export records and let the old plan end at renewal.
Which Classplus alternative is best for a small coaching institute?

A small institute usually does best with a low fixed cost and a free trial, so it can build and sell before paying much. AllCoaching starts at ₹6,999 a year with a 7-day free trial and no card needed.
Does any Classplus alternative bring students?

Most alternatives are tools; finding students stays your job. AllCoaching also lists your courses on the AllCoaching marketplace app, which helps discovery, but your own website, YouTube, Instagram and WhatsApp remain the main ways students find you.
